items.text: Glossary applied (preferred terms + banned calques + do-not-translate)
Locale style guide followed (formality T/V, punctuation, units, currency)
Correct approach used: transcreate marketing, precise legal, adapt SEO
No invented testimonials, certifications, or statistics
Brand/product names stable unless glossary allows localized form
Keywords adapted to local query language; one primary keyword per URL
No machine-English calques or literal idioms
ICU / placeholders intact and correctly ordered
Information parity with source (or documented intentional omission)
Internal links localized; no cross-locale leaks
RTL locales: dir, logical CSS advice, mirrored affordances, fonts
UI strings fit layout; CTAs match local conversion language
Legal/high-risk claims marked needs_native_review when agent is not a specialist
Below-bar pages are noindex or omitted from hreflang until ready
